tokens.name: zed
tokens.usage: Brand. The ground for the header, the Wall hero, Ones pages, the office screen and the launch. Text on white (19.8:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand. The page for working screens; text on Zed. Kept as pure white because the brand fixes it (DEC-028).

tokens.name: electric
tokens.usage: Brand. ONLY things you can press: buttons, links, focus rings, a selected choice. White on it 5.2:1; on white 5.2:1; on Zed only at 24 px and up (3.8:1).

tokens.name: electric-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of Electric. White on it 7.2:1.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Brand. The outlier: the one hot thing on a screen (the mark's spark, a lit slash tip, the heat of a page with no One's tier). 6.4:1 on Zed. As light and fill; never text on white, never on Electric. A One's Tier 1 is tier-1 (#ff7f14), not this colour (DEC-098).

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on Zed; the paused-feature band on every surface.

tokens.name: coal
tokens.usage: Hover and second raise on Zed. Ash on it 6.3:1.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text on Zed (7.8:1) and Graphite (7.0:1). Never on white.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white (6.1:1) and Paper (5.6:1).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, unchecked boxes, empty slashes. 4.6:1 on white, 4.3:1 on Zed (needs 3:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The second neutral layer on white: panels, idea cards, table heads. Zed on it 18.1:1, Electric 4.8:1.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Hover on white rows and panels.

tokens.name: line-light
tokens.usage: Decorative borders on white (dividers, card edges). Never a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: line-dark
tokens.usage: Decorative borders on Zed.

tokens.name: link-on-zed
tokens.usage: Links and focus rings on Zed and Graphite, where Electric is too dark for text (7.5:1 on Zed). Same as the emails' dark links.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The brand ground of the current surface (White or Zed). Screens stand on `matte`; `surface` is for print-like areas and fallbacks.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Opaque fallback for glass where blur is not available, and table heads. Glass is the default raise now.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, cards and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. 19.8:1 either way round.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, 'Why we ask', meta. 6.1:1 on white, 7.8:1 on Zed.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, radios, empty slashes. Passes 3:1 on both surfaces.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Fill of the liquid primary button; edge of a glass secondary button; a selected choice.

tokens.name: press-hover
tokens.usage: The darker Electric that floods a primary button from the pointer on hover and press. White on it 7.2:1.

tokens.name: press-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a pressable fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links and secondary-button text on the current surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3 px focus ring. Always visible, never removed.

tokens.name: selected-wash
tokens.usage: The liquid that fills a selected choice card from the bottom, always with the Electric edge and a ticked radio, never alone.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors and the personal-data block: text, border, glyph. 6.6:1 on white, 8.6:1 on Zed. Always with a glyph and words.

tokens.name: error-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a highlighted personal-data match.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: 'Check first' and work-contact warnings. 6.6:1 on its wash.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a 'Check first' notice and a warn-level personal-data match.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: The 'Checked' state of a file and similar quiet confirmations. Always with a check glyph. 6.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: heat
tokens.usage: The colour of the one hot thing on the screen, and of the warm light on a Zed stage. Spark until someone is a One; then their tier colour (set by data-tier, see Spark tiers). Light and fills only, never small text.

tokens.name: heat-core
tokens.usage: The white-hot centre of a lit slash tip and the top of a jersey number. Also the text colour for a One's number in a chip (at least 12:1 on Graphite at every tier). Each tier sets its own tint.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of every glass surface: panels, cards, fields, secondary buttons. On White it is nearly opaque white, a clear step brighter than the matte ground (Ink 18:1, Slate 5.7:1 at worst). On Zed the glass is smoked (the backdrop is dimmed 45% first), so White is 12:1 and Ash 4.7:1 over the brightest tier's light.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1 px outer edge of glass. Decorative; a control's boundary is line-control or press.

tokens.name: glass-shine
tokens.usage: The top rim highlight and the light that follows the pointer across glass.

tokens.name: dock
tokens.usage: Thick dark glass on any surface: the menu sheet, the success pill, the recorder. Over a white page White on it is 13:1 and Ash 5.5:1, so small and muted text is safe.

tokens.name: dock-thin
tokens.usage: Thin dark glass: the header bar only. The page shows and bends through it. White text only: 7:1 over a white page (nav labels at 80% white, 5.2:1). Ash fails on it.

tokens.name: matte
tokens.usage: The stage: the flat, grained ground every screen stands on. No lines, no pattern. On White, Ink on it is 17:1, Slate 5.3:1; on Zed, White 18:1, Ash 7.4:1.

tokens.name: matte-deep
tokens.usage: The far end of the stage's one slow gradient (top to bottom). Slate on it 4.9:1.

tokens.name: link-ground
tokens.usage: Text links and quiet buttons that sit straight on the matte ground, where Electric would drop to 4.2:1. 5.8:1 or better. On glass, links stay Electric.

tokens.name: tier-1
tokens.usage: Tier 1, Spark. The heat colour at this tier: glow, the warm light on a Zed stage, lit slash tips, the jersey number's lower half. Only on Zed or Graphite (7.8:1 on Zed, 7.0:1 on Graphite).

tokens.name: tier-2
tokens.usage: Tier 2, Glow. The heat colour at this tier: glow, the warm light on a Zed stage, lit slash tips, the jersey number's lower half. Only on Zed or Graphite (5.7:1 on Zed, 5.1:1 on Graphite).

tokens.name: tier-3
tokens.usage: Tier 3, Flame. The heat colour at this tier: glow, the warm light on a Zed stage, lit slash tips, the jersey number's lower half. Only on Zed or Graphite (5.5:1 on Zed, 4.9:1 on Graphite).

tokens.name: tier-4
tokens.usage: Tier 4, Blaze. The heat colour at this tier: glow, the warm light on a Zed stage, lit slash tips, the jersey number's lower half. Only on Zed or Graphite (4.9:1 on Zed, 4.4:1 on Graphite). Too dark for small text: use heat-core for words and this colour for the glow.

tokens.name: tier-5
tokens.usage: Tier 5, White heat. The heat colour at this tier: glow, the warm light on a Zed stage, lit slash tips, the jersey number's lower half. Only on Zed or Graphite (10.3:1 on Zed, 9.2:1 on Graphite).

tokens.name: tier-6
tokens.usage: Tier 6, Blue flame. The heat colour at this tier: glow, the warm light on a Zed stage, lit slash tips. Only on Zed or Graphite (3.6:1 on Zed, 3.2:1 on Graphite). Too dark for small text: use heat-core for words and this colour for the glow. Too dark for the number's lower half too: the app ends the number on color-mix(in srgb, this 80%, #fff), about 5:1 on Zed and at least 3.9:1 on Graphite and the glow-up sheet (BLD-D007).

tokens.name: tier-7
tokens.usage: Tier 7, Star. The heat colour at this tier: glow, the warm light on a Zed stage, lit slash tips. Only on Zed or Graphite (2.8:1 on Zed, 2.5:1 on Graphite). Too dark for small text: use heat-core for words and this colour for the glow. Too dark for the number's lower half too: the app ends the number on color-mix(in srgb, this 70%, #fff), about 5:1 on Zed and at least 3.9:1 on Graphite and the glow-up sheet (BLD-D007).

styles.name: display-160
styles.usage: Launch, Wall hero at 1440. Steps down to display-64 at 360 px.

styles.name: display-96
styles.usage: Brand page heroes: home band, Wall, journey.

styles.name: display-64
styles.sample: What the Ones are up to
styles.usage: Brand section heads; heroes at 360 px.

styles.name: display-44
styles.usage: Glow-up and dashboard headline; brand heads at 360 px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: One per working screen. 30 px at 360.

styles.name: body-long
styles.sample: Every month-end the team rebuilds the same reconciliation sheet by hand.
styles.usage: What people type and read at length: canvas answers, summaries, The Ember.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The review desk looks at it within 5 working days.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Why we ask: one clear line is what gets read first.
styles.usage: Hints, meta, table secondary text. Nothing smaller on employee screens.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons. 15 px on small desk buttons, 18 px on brand CTAs.

styles.name: jersey-200
styles.usage: A One's own number on their dashboard and the glow-up. Geist Mono only ever sets jersey numbers and the compounding line.

styles.name: jersey-96
styles.usage: One cards on the Wall, home and office screens.

styles.name: jersey-40
styles.usage: Leaderboard rows, console roster, email number block.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip; between slashes.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to hint; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; choice card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 360 px; panel padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; field to field.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 1440; question to question in the canvas.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section to section on working screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Before a brand band; between canvas sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Brand band padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Brand hero padding at 1440.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed brand bands only. Everything else is glass, and glass is never square.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, textareas, selects, file rows. Checkboxes 8px.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Glass cards: idea and match cards, status glass, choice tiles, the table.

tokens.name: radius-slab
tokens.usage: Glass sheets: dialogs, jerseys, the meter, confirm panels, Zed slabs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything you press or that names a state: buttons, chips, the dock, the section nav. Round like the mark's zeros.

shadow.note: Elevation on white is a fill (Paper) or a line; on Zed it is lightness (Graphite, Coal). A shadow means 'this floats over the page' and nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Glass that floats over the page: dialogs, the header dock, the mobile sheet, the toast.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: The lift under glass cards and panels: a tight contact shadow and a wide soft one. On a matte ground this, with the lit rim, is what makes glass read as thick.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: The inner shadow of a well: inputs and anything you type or drop into sits below the glass, not above it.

duration.note: Motion timings, borrowed in shape from Astryx's motion roles (press, state change, reveal). Exits run at 75% of the entrance.

tokens.name: t-press
tokens.usage: Button press, checkbox tick.

tokens.name: t-state
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, colour change, disclosure open. Also the cap for every reduced-motion cross-fade.

tokens.name: t-reveal
tokens.usage: A result arriving: match cards, a dialog, a section opening.

tokens.name: t-scene
tokens.usage: A choreographed moment: the checks igniting, the hundred filling, the share flood, a confirm panel growing out of its button.

tokens.name: t-spring
tokens.usage: A spring settling: a press releasing, a card landing, the nav thumb sliding, a tile lifting.

tokens.name: t-glow
tokens.usage: The glow-up only: the spark heating from the old tier to the new (DEC-084).

easing.note: ease-out is the expo-out curve Lenis scrolls with (1.001 - 2^-10t). ease-move is Astryx's curves.move, used for cross-fades. No bounce, no elastic.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Arrivals and answers that have no mass: light, colour, text.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Overshoot and settle, for things with mass: buttons, tiles, the nav thumb, nodes igniting. Never for text.

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: Cross-fades, colour heat, and every reduced-motion replacement.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only (dialog closing, a toast leaving).

size.note: Fixed measures the layout leans on.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything you press on employee screens (44 px is the floor; 48 is the default).

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: The glass dock. It floats 12 px below the top edge, so pages reserve 80 px.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of reading text.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Content width on working screens.

meta.source: docs/BRAND.md (DEC-027 to DEC-052, DEC-075 to DEC-084) and apps/web/src/app/globals.css at 2bb00cf; semantic layer and scales by lane D; liquid-glass material, heat and tier dials added 11 Nov 2026

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of a pane: enough that text on it never depends on what is behind. Lenses use 0 to 2 px so what is behind stays readable and bends at the rim.

tokens.name: blur-frost
tokens.usage: Frost: the paused band only. Anything deliberately stopped. A dialog's backdrop is not frosted: it is dimmed 72% and blurred 3 px so the page still bends at the sheet's rim.
